<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A panel with recent events: a timeline with dots on a line, or a list of rows with an icon. Axes: layout
  (timeline, list), density (default, compact), tone (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Event } from "./activity-feed.types";

  export type ActivityFeedProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    events: Event[];
    empty?: string;
    layout?: "timeline" | "list";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import Panel from "../components/panel.svelte";
  import Timeline from "../components/timeline.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    events,
    empty = "",
    layout = "timeline",
    density = "default",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ActivityFeedProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : ((title && id) ? tpl("{0}-t", id) : undefined))}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="panel-section"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4 py-8" data-slot="container">
    <Panel title={title} description={text} id={id} class={(((tone as string) === "muted") ? "bg-muted" : "")}>
      {#if ((events?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
        <EmptyState icon="activity" title={empty} />
      {:else if ((layout as string) === "timeline")}
        <Timeline items={events} />
      {:else}
        <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col p-0" data-slot="items">
          {#each events as e (e.id)}
            <ListItem
              class={cn(
                "flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border last:border-0",
                (((density as string) === "compact") ? "py-2" : "py-4")
              )}
              data-slot="item"
            >
              <Stack gap="0">
                <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                  {e.title}
                </Text>
                {#if ((density as string) === "default")}
                  <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                    {e.text}
                  </Text>
                {/if}
              </Stack>
              <Text size="xs" class="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground">
                {e.time}
              </Text>
            </ListItem>
          {/each}
        </List>
      {/if}
    </Panel>
  </Container>
</Block>
